title: LARP: the people who look rich are paying for it
hook: Nice car. Nice bag. Looks rich, right?
caption:
Looks rich, right? The car goes back after the shoot. What's left is the bill. Spend {flex} of your pay on looking rich for {years} years and it resells for {stuff_left} years of salary. The same money, owned quietly, is about {kept_med} years of salary. The people who look rich are usually the ones paying for it.

(Simulation: {dep} yearly loss in resale value, {ret} real return, {vol} volatility, median outcome, no taxes or fees. An illustration of a mechanism, not a plan.)

scenes.say: Nice car. Nice bag. Looks rich, right?
The post goes up. The likes roll in.
Then the shoot ends. The car goes back. The bag goes back in its box.
Looking rich is a subscription. {flex} of every paycheck, just to stay seen.
Meanwhile, someone nobody follows keeps the same money.
After {years} years, the flex resells for {stuff_left} years of pay. Kept quietly, it's {kept_med}.

scenes.say: The people who look rich are usually the ones paying for it.
Nobody remembers your car. Your bank account remembers everything.

dark-story.takeaway: Nobody remembers your car. Your bank account remembers everything.
dark-story.about: Photo shoot with a car that isn't theirs, the reveal, the subscription to being seen, the quiet one who keeps the money.
